compute_mpjpe: compute mean per-joint position error between predicted and target 3D pose sequences
compute_weighted_mpjpe: compute weighted mean per-joint position error with per-sample weights for pose evaluation
compute_p_mpjpe: compute pose error after rigid alignment with scale, rotation, and translation for Protocol #2
compute_n_mpjpe: compute normalized MPJPE with scale-only normalization between predicted and target poses
compute_mean_velocity_error: compute mean per-joint velocity error between predicted and target pose sequences
